QuestInfo.name: Rain's Maple Quiz 7
QuestInfo.1: Finally, the last question. After this, I'll be a true Mapler.
QuestInfo.2: #b#p19##k advised that it's time to leave Maple Island. In Victoria Island, I can choose a job and start a lot of new adventures. Head to #b#m60##k to get to Victoria Island!

0.0: All right, last question! Talk to me when you're ready.

1.0:
This is important! You can only make the job advancement at Victoria Island, but you're currently on Maple Island. Where do you go to get a ride to Victoria Island? 

#L0# #b#m60#
#L1# #m1010#
#L2# No way I can get there!#k#l
1.1: That's absolutely correct. Head over to #b#m60##k, talk to #b#p15##k, and get on the #rship#k that heads to Victoria Island.

yes.0: Once you get there, the first thing you want to do is get your job advancement. You should make sure you're at the right level to advance. Head to #bPerion#k to become a Warrior, #b#m10001000##k to become a Bowman, #b#m10003000##k to be a Thief, #b#m10002000##k to be a Magician. If you get lost, open the #bWorld Map#k. All right, happy Mapling!

0.1: You won't find any ports at #m1010#. Head over to the only place in Maple Island with a port to catch a ride to Victoria Island.
0.2: You won't be able to come back once you leave this place, but trust me, you CAN leave...
